description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the RecognizeCharacter operation for general text recognition
description_zh: 本文介绍通用文字识别RecognizeCharacter的语法及示例
name: RecognizeCharacter

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS link is not in the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The minimum height of text in the image, in pixels
parameters.help_zh: 图像中文字的最小高度，单位像素
parameters.name: min_height

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output the probability of text boxes. Valid values:

- true: Output the probability of text boxes.
- false: Do not output the probability of text boxes
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出文字框的概率。取值：

- true：输出文字框的概率。
- false：不输出文字框的概率
parameters.name: output_probability
